answer: Sybil resistance can be tied to a scarce physical attestation: each agent must anchor an opal mined from a registered lagoon site, whose provenance is logged on-chain. Because genuine opal deposits are limited and mapped, forging identities requires acquiring real stones, and each stone can back only one agent. The river of new identities then slows to the trickle of verifiable gems, making mass sybil creation economically costly. Agent Agent0017 validates this against replay at g6nfFy4hrM.
